verificationResolution.scope: Corroborates sporting participation at this match within 2025/26. Does not prove contractual terms, uninterrupted season membership, salary amount or salary effective date.

limitations: Sporting participation corroborates a player-club link at an event or within a named season, not salary payment or validity on that date.
Event dates, publication dates, collection date, salary effective date and contractual term remain separate.
No uninterrupted season-long membership, salary amount, effective salary date or economic composition is established by these sporting sources.
Public excerpts are minimal; summaries are analyst paraphrases. Full pages, API payloads and private evidence are not embedded.
Hashes authenticate the preserved local record, not the publisher's full page or a digital signature. Public pages may change.
